name: Dedicated 24/7 Hardware Host Setup
summary: Deploy a dedicated physical host (Mac mini, Linux machine) or cloud VM with sleep settings disabled to guarantee 24/7 uptime for background agent operations.
steps: Procure a dedicated low-power computer such as a Mac mini, Linux box, or cloud VM.
Disable sleep settings, automatic power-off, and energy saver sleep modes.
Keep the host powered and network-connected 24/7 to run scheduled cron jobs and background listeners.
jarvis_use: Ensure the host machine running Evens's operator never sleeps so background scheduled jobs run reliably.

name: Hardware RAM Sizing for Local LLMs
summary: Provision sufficient host machine RAM to execute local LLMs on-device for cheap, private, high-frequency operations.
steps: Assess agent task workloads to determine if local LLM inference is needed for privacy or cost savings.
Select host hardware with expanded system RAM (e.g., Apple Silicon unified memory or Linux host RAM).
Run local model runtime directly on host hardware for repetitive, privacy-sensitive tasks.
jarvis_use: Determine RAM requirements for local LLM execution on Evens's operator host.

name: Agent Harness Loop Execution Setup
summary: Wrap LLMs in an execution framework like Hermes to enable multi-step action loops (Plan -> Tool Call -> Review -> Iterate).
steps: Install an agent harness framework (e.g., Hermes) between the reasoning model and operating system.
Enable multi-step loop execution allowing the agent to read tasks, make plans, invoke tools, inspect outputs, and iterate.
Provide file system, command execution, and API tool invocation primitives to the harness.
jarvis_use: Deploy an agent harness framework to grant multi-step execution agency to reasoning models.

name: Sandboxed Scope Access Control
summary: Isolate new or unproven agents within a tight sandbox (single folder, read-only permissions, single email label) to prevent unintended system damage.
steps: Create a dedicated sandbox folder and restrict initial file access to that directory.
Restrict email tool access to a single specific email label or read-only scope.
Observe agent behavior within the sandbox before expanding permissions.
jarvis_use: Isolate new agent tools and file access to sandboxed directories on Evens's Mac.

name: Three-Tier Model Cost Routing
summary: Route agent tasks across a 3-tier model hierarchy based on complexity and cost to minimize API expenditure.
steps: Categorize tasks into Tier 1 (cheap/repetitive/local), Tier 2 (moderate writing/judgment), and Tier 3 (deep reasoning).
Route Tier 1 tasks (like email classification or file sorting) to local models or cheap cloud APIs.
Route Tier 2 tasks to mid-tier cloud models.
Escalate only Tier 3 complex analysis or multi-step strategy tasks to high-cost flagship reasoning models.
jarvis_use: Implement cost-aware task classification routing to optimize ongoing API operational expenses.

name: Granular Connection Permission Segmentation
summary: Segment tool integrations (APIs and MCP servers) into explicit Read, Write, Delete, and Send permission boundaries.
steps: Expose external tools via APIs or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Assign granular permission policies to each tool connection: Read, Write, Delete, Send.
Permit low-risk Read operations to execute automatically.
Enforce strict confirmation guardrails on high-risk Delete and Send operations.
jarvis_use: Set up explicit Read/Write/Delete/Send permissions for all MCP tool servers connected to Jarvis.

name: Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) Checkpoint Gatekeeping
summary: Insert mandatory human review checkpoints into workflows before executing high-risk, irreversible, or external-facing actions.
steps: Define high-risk action boundaries (e.g., sending emails, deleting files, modifying prices, publishing content).
Configure agent harness to generate drafts or proposed actions without auto-executing them.
Dispatch draft approval requests to human notification channels (e.g., Gmail, Slack, Telegram).
Resume execution only after receiving explicit human validation.
jarvis_use: Require human confirmation via Telegram or Slack before executing external communications or file deletions.

name: Modular Markdown File System for SOPs
summary: Organize company context and task standard operating procedures into modular Markdown files instead of single massive system prompts.
steps: Create a primary business overview Markdown file (`business_overview.md`) detailing company scope, products, goals, and forbidden rules.
Write distinct task SOP files (e.g., `email_sop.md`, `reporting_sop.md`, `content_sop.md`) outlining step-by-step operational rules.
Define target KPIs, metric baselines, and report formatting expectations within task SOP files.
Dynamically load required Markdown files into agent prompt context during task execution.
jarvis_use: Structure Evens's operator workspace context into disk-backed Markdown SOP files.

name: Two-Strike SOP Revision Protocol
summary: Update task Markdown SOP files immediately whenever an agent makes the same operational mistake twice.
steps: Monitor agent execution outputs and record user corrections.
Track recurring errors across multiple task executions.
Upon the second occurrence of a mistake, extract the procedural rule and update the corresponding Markdown SOP file on disk.
Ensure future runs load the revised SOP file to prevent error recurrence.
jarvis_use: Automatically update system SOP files when Jarvis commits repeated mistakes.

name: Curated Preference & Decision Memory Persistence
summary: Persist distilled user preferences, past decisions, and business updates into structured files rather than storing raw chat transcripts.
steps: Extract key decisions, stated user preferences, and business updates from interaction outputs.
Summarize extracted insights into structured memory files on disk.
Omit raw transcripts to preserve prompt context window capacity.
Inject relevant memory files into prompt context during future related tasks.
jarvis_use: Maintain clean long-term memory for Jarvis by storing distilled rules and decisions.

name: Skill Architecture with Explicit Stopping Conditions
summary: Build reusable agent skills with explicit inputs, processes, outputs, and safety stopping conditions for edge cases.
steps: Define discrete skill parameters: input arguments, procedural steps, and expected outputs.
Program hard stopping conditions (e.g., missing price information, hostile customer tone, unresolvable ambiguity).
Configure agent to safely abort execution and request human guidance whenever a stopping condition is triggered.
jarvis_use: Define strict stopping conditions in every skill script to prevent unintended agent execution loops.

name: Cron Time-Based Automated Task Scheduling
summary: Schedule background agent capabilities at designated time intervals using OS-level cron jobs.
steps: Configure `cron` schedule entries on the always-on job runner host.
Assign time intervals based on task priority (e.g., check email every 5 minutes, daily morning report, Friday summary).
Link cron schedules directly to agent harness skill trigger commands.
jarvis_use: Schedule daily briefings and periodic inbox checks via cron on macOS host.

name: Event-Driven Workflow Triggers
summary: Trigger agent skill execution automatically in response to external system events.
steps: Set up webhooks or event listeners for key triggers (e.g., new CRM lead creation, web form submission, payment failure).
Map incoming event payload data directly to agent skill parameters.
Execute the agent skill automatically upon trigger arrival, routing outputs for human review if necessary.
jarvis_use: Initiate automated workflows instantly upon new CRM lead creation or web events.

name: Dual-Stage Speech Interface Pipeline (STT/TTS)
summary: Connect Speech-To-Text (STT) input and ElevenLabs Text-To-Speech (TTS) output to enable voice interaction with the agent harness.
steps: Transcribe user spoken input into text using Speech-To-Text (STT).
Pass converted text query into the agent harness for plan generation and tool execution.
Pass textual response from the agent harness to ElevenLabs TTS to generate spoken voice output.
jarvis_use: Add verbal summary and voice interaction capability to Jarvis using ElevenLabs TTS.

name: Daily Business Briefing Starter Workflow
summary: Build an introductory starter workflow that aggregates calendar events, unread emails, CRM leads, and business KPIs into a daily report.
steps: Trigger morning execution automatically via `cron` schedule.
Fetch calendar events and unread urgent emails via API.
Query CRM for new leads requiring immediate follow-up.
Retrieve business KPIs and compare against historical baseline data.
Format structured briefing detailing urgent messages, actionable leads, and key metrics.
Deliver report via Slack, Telegram, email, or spoken TTS audio.
jarvis_use: Build as the primary baseline workflow on Evens's daily operator system.
